signature.name: VTask.copy

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total constructor-like definition with no junk-value inputs or edge conventions; every triple (f, f', h) satisfying the stated types produces a well-formed ContinuousAlgHom.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [TopologicalSpace A] {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [TopologicalSpace B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →A[R] B) (f' : A → B) (h : f' = ⇑f), VTask.copy f f' h = f
